chunks: Jābir narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"When the first day of Shawwāl arrives, a caller calls out: O believers, go forth to your rewards."
Then he said: "O Jābir, the rewards of Allah are not like the rewards of these kings."
Then he said: "It is the Day of Rewards."

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُونَ: the believers being addressed and summoned
key_terms.الْمُلُوكِ: kings, whose worldly gifts are contrasted with divine rewards
key_terms.جَوَائِزِكُمْ: your rewards or gifts prepared for you
key_terms.شَوَّالٍ: Shawwāl, the month whose first day is Eid al-Fiṭr
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْجَوَائِزِ: the Day of Rewards, describing Eid al-Fiṭr

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the first day of Shawwāl and the rewards of Eid al-Fiṭr?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the first day of Shawwāl as a day on which the believers are called to receive divine rewards. It emphasizes that Allah’s gifts far surpass worldly gifts, presenting Eid al-Fiṭr as a sacred occasion of grace and recompense after worship.
